searchText: I would recommend reading the white paper and the yellow paper https://youtube.com/c/EthereumEngineeringGroup White and yellowpaper won't get you very far with geths codebase. I thought about creating a twitch or something to go through the code and explain everything and the patterns we use, but didn't know if anyone would be interested this would be extremely useful imo, esp for engineers/researchers looking to contribute etc Erigon has a few useful guides on their repo’s wiki, too <@!595709641724264468>
